title: M7.P5: Scope temporary paths to the build execution environment
body:
## Qualification reconciliation — 2026-10-11

Original build20 rc2 and build20b observer rc1 remain unchanged. Pinned nonroot negative/positive temporary-path controls, actual build20b container0 and independent build20-verify0 establish effective container /tmp. Source/installed checks and subsequent clean/upgrade qualification pass. See [original and corrected build receipts](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/b990d32c935c557ba8808cfedb7344730eee60fe/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-container-temporary-path) and [corrected clean/upgrade qualification](https://github.com/pixelelated/distribution/tree/b990d32c935c557ba8808cfedb7344730eee60fe/docs/qa-logs/2026-10-11-pixelelated-replacement-20).

The earlier remaining-work statements below are historical; the acceptance checklist is reconciled to the evidence above. No owner device/cloud action or publication occurred.

## Build invocation failure

Maintainer: “Let's fix any caps we discover before we generate a new build. Since we know that this will be the next build, we'll feel better about doing some of the cloud. If we're finding issues along the way, we should resolve them now.”

The first corrected-image owner /workspace/tmp/pixelelated-m7-build20 ended2 before compilation. Its explicitly supplied host TMPDIR was forwarded through scripts/get_env into Docker, but that host path was not mounted. Package-clean initialization correctly failed at mktemp. The source freeze and full cache checksum/inode checks passed; this is an invocation boundary error, not a product failure. Original inner/outer/launcher results remain unchanged.

Can this be done on the VM? The container/host boundary is verified on this build host using the pinned unprivileged Docker image. The resulting firmware still requires clean and upgrade VM qualification under #548. No physical device or personal cloud is involved.

Already written: no new firmware was produced. The previous accepted image and product source remain unchanged.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Preserve the original failure and demonstrate the host-only temporary path refusal versus a container-local temporary path using the same pinned image and nonroot user.
- [x] A fresh watched build owner explicitly scopes its container TMPDIR, records the actual running container environment and consumes original command/outer/launcher results. No frozen product source or existing result is overwritten.
- [x] Work log, friction record and build instructions capture the host/container temporary-path boundary; the corrected assembled image still proceeds through #548 qualification.

Parent #344; discovered while building #548. This owns execution-environment scope only.

Maintainer clarification: “any caps we…” meant “any gaps”. The request is to resolve gaps, not change capitalization.
